$schema_note: Phase 0 SQL inventory (MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md Task 3). Per MWC26 §6, every SQL surface listed here is classified Migrate (move to DatabaseDialect + typed query builder) or Remove (delete the calling code with the feature it backs). Counts come from ripgrep over src/ at upstream baseline 696f277b37 and are approximate. The exhaustive per-query list — file, line, SQL text, predicates, indexes hit/missed — is built lazily by tools/audit.php when it runs (Phase 1 prerequisite); this artifact sizes the work and lists the hot paths so Phase 2 / Phase 6 has a target.
scope: wp_posts, wp_postmeta, wp_options, wp_usermeta, wp_terms, wp_term_relationships, wp_comments (the seven tables MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md Task 3 names).

action_legend.Migrate: Move to the Phase 2 DatabaseDialect / typed query builder. wpdb::prepare() becomes a thin wrapper for the conversion duration and is deleted when no core caller uses it directly.
action_legend.Remove: Delete the calling code with the feature it backs (e.g. SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS, FTP/SSH fallback path, classic-editor meta_query).

primary_query_classes: src/wp-includes/class-wp-query.php (the canonical post query; SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS = 2 occurrences)
hot_paths: WP_Query::get_posts() — main post SELECT with status, post_type, post_parent, author, taxonomy joins
WP_Query::next_post() / the_post() loop — sequential post fetch
tables_joined.rationale: Core content table. Phase 4A's typed Content service replaces WP_Query as the canonical query path; wpdb::prepare() calls inside post.php migrate to the typed builder module by module.

hot_paths: update_metadata() — write path with serialized values
performance_hot_spots: Generic EAV string free-for-all (Phase 6 moves registered/core-owned meta to typed columns)
Serialized meta values that defeat index use
wp_postmeta.rationale: Phase 6 reserves generic meta for genuinely arbitrary plugin data and adds typed columns / registered-schema paths for core-owned meta. WP_Query's meta_query is removed per AGENTS.md; callers needing structured post meta go through the typed Content service.

hot_paths: get_option() — read with autoload fetch on first call
wp_load_alloptions() — pulls every autoload=yes row at boot
set_transient() / get_transient() (transients still on wp_options until Phase 6)
performance_hot_spots: Transients on wp_options (Phase 6 moves to its own table per AGENTS.md removal list)
Rewrite-rule cache stored as one giant option (Phase 6 moves to its own table)
Serialized large option payloads (Phase 6 splits into per-key storage)
wp_options.rationale: Phase 6 rebuilds wp_options as a cache-backed typed configuration store; autoload audit, transient move-out, and rewrite-rule cache move-out all land there. Per-MWC26 §7.5.

hot_paths: Application password storage (per MWC26 §11 preserved by Phase 4A)
performance_hot_spots: EAV string free-for-all (Phase 6 mirrors the wp_postmeta treatment)
Session token lookup using meta_query without a covering index
wp_usermeta.rationale: Same pattern as wp_postmeta. Phase 4A's Users service replaces generic user_meta with typed user columns for core-owned metadata (last_login, session tokens, capability-cache invalidation keys).

hot_paths: wp_set_object_terms() — term assignment with relationship write
performance_hot_spots: get_terms() with no cache warm-up is called on every page load for nav menus + tag clouds
Hierarchical taxonomy walk uses recursive queries — flagged for the Phase 0 inventory to count
wp_terms.rationale: Phase 4A's typed Taxonomy service replaces the procedural surface.

hot_paths: wp_set_object_terms() — DELETE + INSERT pairs (transactional in Phase 2)
performance_hot_spots: Composite (object_id, term_taxonomy_id) index is critical; missing or fragmented in older installs
N+1 risk when a WP_Query returns many posts and each gets terms fetched
wp_term_relationships.rationale: Phase 2's transaction support wraps wp_set_object_terms()'s DELETE + INSERT pair as a single transaction (no more partial state on failure). Phase 4A moves the typed read/write through the Taxonomy service.

performance_hot_spots: Comment moderation query lacks a covering index on (comment_approved, comment_date_gmt) in many installs
Recursive comment threading via parent lookups is N+1-prone
wp_comments.rationale: Phase 4B's Comments service uses the Phase 2 transaction support (MWC26 §7.5) for status mutation so partial state can't happen on failure. Comment threading uses the typed builder's batching to remove N+1 access.

wp_query.rationale: The canonical SELECT. Phase 4A's typed Content service is the replacement for end-user callers; the class itself migrates module-by-module.

wp_comment_query.rationale: Phase 4B's Comments service. Status-mutation goes through Phase 2's transactional path.

wp_user_query.rationale: Phase 4A's Users service. SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS removed per Phase 6.

wp_site_query.rationale: Phase 4B's Multisite service. SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS removed per Phase 6.

sql_calc_found_rows.replacement: Typed query builder's COUNT() support per Phase 6

unbounded_posts_per_page.rationale: Found 16 occurrences of posts_per_page=-1 patterns. Phase 6 replaces with explicit cursoring / keyset pagination.
files_to_audit: src/wp-admin/* (export tools, privacy tools, list tables)

local_plus_gmt_dual_writes.rationale: wp_posts (post_date + post_date_gmt, post_modified + post_modified_gmt) and wp_comments (comment_date + comment_date_gmt) dual-write. Phase 6 stores UTC and converts at the seam, eliminating the dual columns' insert/update cost.

serialized_meta_blobs.rationale: Index-defeating serialized values in wp_postmeta / wp_usermeta. Phase 6's registered-schema path moves registered/core-owned meta to typed columns; arbitrary plugin meta keeps generic storage but with explicit JSON typing.

audit_status.current_state: Phase 0 SQL inventory covers the seven required tables at the file-class level. Per-query enumeration (file, line, SQL text, predicates, indexes hit/missed) is a Phase 1 prerequisite; tools/audit.php will emit it when written.
next_actions: Phase 2 implements DatabaseDialect + typed query builder; this inventory is the migration target list.
Phase 2 implements transactional wp_set_object_terms() and the comment status-mutation path per MWC26 §7.4-§7.5.
Phase 6 applies the composite + covering indexes identified here, removes SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS, and moves transients + rewrite rules off wp_options.
